title: Martin Auto Museum

services.name: Daily Admission
services.desc: General admission to all 200+ vintage automobiles in the collection. Self-guided tour, ~90 minutes

services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: Three indoor spaces and an outdoor patio inside a museum of 200+ collector cars in Glendale, Arizona. Three indoor rooms and an outdoor patio sit inside one address, each sized for a different kind of evening - a board meeting for ten, a seminar for a hundred, a gala for five hundred. Every booking opens the museum to your guests: the full gallery of 200-plus collector cars, the game room with its racing games, and the vintage passenger carousel. Outside catering and alcohol are welcome, with a prep area, refrigeration and bartender service available. Tables, chairs, linens, audio-visual and security are included, and parking is on site near Thunderbird Road and 43rd
